integrity: Analytic all-k reflected-core and all-positive-delta physical-walk proofs; exact-rational core checks k=2..150 and 705 physical-lattice node checks. Classical Levy arcsine theorem is the identified external theorem. Independent validation not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Explicit finite closed core measures only at delta=2^{-(k+2)} for integers k>=2, not every small delta. The separate physical-time pointwise arcsine law is proved directly on a countable dyadic lattice for all 0<delta<=1/6, not Lebesgue-a.e. starting positions. Core measure uniqueness is only on the finite graph; publication-priority risk remains.
title: Dyadic finite core chains and pointwise arcsine laws below the generalized Hata–Yano threshold
